enabled.title: Enable IAM Auth
enabled.description: Enable AWS IAM authentication. When enabled, uses the default credential provider chain (environment variables, instance profile, etc.). Defaults to false for backward compatibility.

profileName.title: Profile Name
profileName.description: The name of a profile to use with the boto session.

assumeRoleArn.title: Role Arn for Assume Role
assumeRoleArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to assume. Required Field in case of Assume Role

assumeRoleSessionName.title: Role Session Name for Assume Role
assumeRoleSessionName.description: An identifier for the assumed role session. Use the role session name to uniquely identify a session when the same role is assumed by different principals or for different reasons. Required Field in case of Assume Role

assumeRoleSourceIdentity.title: Source Identity for Assume Role
assumeRoleSourceIdentity.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to assume. Optional Field in case of Assume Role

databaseName.title: Database Name
databaseName.description: Optional name to give to the database in OpenMetadata. If left blank, the Glue Catalog ID (your AWS account ID) is used. This only names the database in OpenMetadata, it does not select which Glue database to ingest.

connectionOptions.title: Connection Options
connectionOptions.description: Additional connection options to build the URL that can be sent to service during the connection.

connectionArguments.title: Connection Arguments
connectionArguments.description: Additional connection arguments such as security or protocol configs that can be sent to service during connection.

schemaFilterPattern.title: Default Schema Filter Pattern
schemaFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude schemas that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

tableFilterPattern.title: Default Table Filter Pattern
tableFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude tables that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

databaseFilterPattern.title: Default Database Filter Pattern
databaseFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude databases that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

dataQualityConfig.title: Data Quality Configuration
dataQualityConfig.description: Configuration to ingest AWS Glue Data Quality results as OpenMetadata test cases and test case results.

etlJobMapping.title: ETL Job Mapping
etlJobMapping.description: Maps Data Quality results produced by a Glue ETL job, which carry no catalog table, to an OpenMetadata table.

jobName.title: Job Name
jobName.description: Name of the Glue ETL job that evaluates the ruleset.

evaluationContext.title: Evaluation Context
evaluationContext.description: Name of the Evaluate Data Quality node in the job. Leave empty to match every node of the job.

tableFQN.title: Table FQN
tableFQN.description: Fully qualified name of the OpenMetadata table the results belong to.

includeDataQuality.title: Include Data Quality
includeDataQuality.description: Ingest AWS Glue Data Quality rules as test cases and their evaluation runs as test case results.

lookbackDays.title: Lookback Days
lookbackDays.description: Only ingest Data Quality results whose run started within this number of days.

targetServiceName.title: Target Database Service Name
targetServiceName.description: OpenMetadata database service holding the evaluated tables (e.g. an Athena service). Defaults to this Glue service.

targetDatabaseName.title: Target Database Name
targetDatabaseName.description: Database of the target database service that holds the evaluated tables (e.g. awsdatacatalog for Athena). Only used with targetServiceName. Leave empty to search every database of that service.

rulesetFilterPattern.title: Ruleset Filter Pattern
rulesetFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude Data Quality rulesets (or ETL evaluation contexts) that match the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

etlJobMappings.title: ETL Job Mappings
etlJobMappings.description: Table mappings for results produced by Glue ETL jobs that are not attached to a Data Catalog table.

items.title: ETL Job Mapping
items.description: Maps Data Quality results produced by a Glue ETL job, which carry no catalog table, to an OpenMetadata table.

jobName.title: Job Name
jobName.description: Name of the Glue ETL job that evaluates the ruleset.

evaluationContext.title: Evaluation Context
evaluationContext.description: Name of the Evaluate Data Quality node in the job. Leave empty to match every node of the job.

tableFQN.title: Table FQN
tableFQN.description: Fully qualified name of the OpenMetadata table the results belong to.
